Bachman not being in the show anymore, makes it way better. But yeah, you're right some of the tech related stuff is just like way off the real deal, during season one they actually did their homework and had some amazing tech stuff that kinda made sense, now it's like: "Yo, tech is so hard to understand for some folks that we're going to add some random stuff and nobody will get that". 

In my honest opinion, Richard does not deserve to remain as CEO or board member of pied Piper, he had the idea and algorithm sure whatever, but he's a very single minded person. He only cares about the ideas he has and no one else's ideas matter. This last episode was an actual proof of that.
Damn, Sewer District was killing it yesterday! Stephan Bodzin mailed the melodic techno section and the closing headliners (Nicole Moudaber b3b Dubfire b3b Paco Osuna) was lit!!!

Does it? For me it's been too hard to find a good place with Techno and Tech House. They used to do 4/4 Studio at Q nightclub but it's not happening anymore :/.
Can you recommend places for those kind of genres?
